edges: The Victoria Aces won the 2010 Claxton Shield tournament.
Wayne Lundgren won the Helms Award at the Baseball Australia Diamond Awards.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: South Australia defeated the Victoria Aces in the championship series.
South Australia hosted the New South Wales Patriots in the semi-final series.
Matthew Blackmore was named both the Claxton Shield Final Series MVP and Pitcher of the Year.
